messages:
ravi: FYI I opened PR #4821 — rollforward for connpool backpressure fix. Seen a few 95p latency spikes on prod last night under sustained warmup. Can someone take a quick look? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4821
anya: looking now. is this the change that limits in-flight conns to 500?
ravi: yep, main change is clamp + better async drain. added unit + integration tests. notes in PR description about why we saw queue blowup when some clients reconnected.
tom: tagging @oncall: we had two alerts around 03:12-03:18 UTC. are those the same windows?
anya: matches the traces I pulled — a spike aligning with conn growth on host-23. added log snippet in PR.
olivia: can you paste the deploy command we'll use for a canary? I can run it after review.
ravi: canary plan in PR: route 5% of traffic for 15m to canary pool, monitor p95 and 5xx. deploy command: ``./scripts/deploy_canary.sh --pool connpool-canary --image pr-4821``
anya: quick code comment — small nit on variable name in conn_manager.go but not a blocker. leaving an inline suggestion.
sre-bot: [deploy-checklist] integration tests: passed; e2e: flaky (1 failure) — see CI link in PR.
tom: I'll review now, aim to approve in ~20m. if CI flakes we should rerun, but don't block on the nit.
olivia: oncall schedule — I'll be oncall in 30m, happy to watch the canary window and rollback if needed.avi: thanks all. if we get 2 approvals I'll prepare the canary. ping me once CI green + approvals.
anya: approved after nit addressed. rerunning e2e now.
sre-bot: CI: e2e rerun passed.
tom: approved. feel free to roll forward once you kick canary. recommend 30m observation given yesterday's behavior. :thumbsup:
olivia: noted — I'll watch dashboards and paging rules. any special traces to look at?
ravi: focus on conn_count, queue_latency, and auth-service 5xx. I'll post the curl to hit a test path after canary starts.
any further questions?
